title: Sensitive data redaction
description: Security boundaries with a deliberately insecure Node.js learner starter, verified instructor guard, denial cases and explicit production limitations.
objectives: Redact known secret-bearing keys recursively before logging and avoid mutating original request objects or emitting raw tokens.
Explain why an isolated guard or loopback test does not certify production security.
rubric: I can identify the risk described in sensitive data redaction.
I can fix the red starter and verify the denied action.
I can identify at least one untested production boundary.
